summary: A heavier, more mathematically precise reimagining of Terra Mystica, where each of 14 asymmetric factions terraforms hex planets, builds structures, and races up tech tracks in a tight, low-luck economic engine. Every action is a careful optimization puzzle, and games reward efficient long-term planning over reactive tactics.
praised: extremely well-balanced factions despite high asymmetry
deep, satisfying engine-building with almost no luck
gorgeous, thematic production for a euro this crunchy
huge replayability from faction and round-scoring variability
criticised: steep learning curve and heavy rulebook
low direct interaction can feel like solitaire multiplayer
analysis paralysis is common given the many optimization paths

interaction.kind: territory/spatial competition for adjacent hexes, mostly indirect

scoring.why: points accrue from round bonuses, tech tiles, building/research tracks, and end-game scoring, rewarding whichever engine converts resources most efficiently
